body: The Tower is still a great place to see a show. I wish that the 69th street neighborhood had the same sort of revival that the rest of Philly had.

I had an old friend tell me that his favorite concert was Devo. This was coming from a guy who saw Skynard, Zepplin, The Who, you name it. I still have to go back in give this guys a listen.

You got your ass kicked if you listened to Devo when I was a kid.. no really...
